sources.title: Rover Radio Failsafe
sources.exact_quote:
This failsafe is triggered if the connection between the user's transmitter and the receiver on the vehicle is lost for at least :ref:`FS_TIMEOUT <FS_TIMEOUT>` seconds (default = 1 sec).

- the loss of transmitter/receiver connection is detected by:

  - no signals being sent from the receiver to the autopilot board OR
  - the throttle channel (normally input channel 3) value falling below the :ref:`FS_THR_VALUE <FS_THR_VALUE>` parameter value OR
  - RC_OVERRIDES are lost if :ref:`using a GCS only <common-gcs-only-operation>` is being used,
sources.context_summary_zh: 列出连接丢失、低油门和 RC override 丢失三种来源及持续时间。

atomic_propositions.name: low_throttle_start
atomic_propositions.controlled_natural_language: 映射后的 throttle PWM 进入低于阈值的连续区间。
atomic_propositions.truth_condition: valid RC frame 且 chan[RCMAP_THROTTLE] < PARAM_VALUE(FS_THR_VALUE) 的上升沿。
atomic_propositions.validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
atomic_propositions.freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
atomic_propositions.scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Resolves the runtime RCMAP_THROTTLE channel to the Rover throttle input object.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Consumes mapped raw PWM after read_input returned true and last_valid_rc_ms was refreshed.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 66-75 separate unsuccessful and successful input cycles. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/Rover/radio.cpp#L74

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Direct low-throttle comparison against runtime FS_THR_VALUE.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Shared failsafe interval epoch when the first active failsafe bit begins.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime throttle-failsafe mode: disabled, enabled, or enabled-continue-mission-in-Auto.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Direct disabled guard; clears AP_Notify radio flag and bypasses throttle-failsafe evaluation.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 79-83 return when FS_THR_ENABLE is zero. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/Rover/radio.cpp#L79

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Action is delayed by FS_TIMEOUT and suppressed in RTL and normally in Hold.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 70-75 require no prior trigger, active bits, elapsed FS_TIMEOUT, non-RTL mode, and Hold option if in Hold. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/Rover/failsafe.cpp#L70

source_bindings.semantic_identity: When in Auto with FS_THR_ENABLE=2, records the failsafe but continues the mission rather than applying FS_ACTION.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 81-86 implement the continue-mission exception. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/Rover/failsafe.cpp#L81

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime enum selecting None, RTL, Hold, SmartRTL, Terminate, or Loiter/Hold fallback.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Latches all currently active failsafe bits when the shared persistence timeout expires.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Maps runtime FS_ACTION to None, mode transitions with fallbacks, or disarm.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 87-116 implement every action and fallback. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/Rover/failsafe.cpp#L87

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Canonical successful Rover mode-result write for RTL/Hold/SmartRTL/Loiter actions.
source_bindings.evidence: On successful entry, lines 269 and 284 write the mode and ModeReason; line 288 queues HEARTBEAT. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/Rover/system.cpp#L269

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Terminate action result with cause-specific disarm method.
source_bindings.evidence: FailsafeAction::Terminate directly requests disarm. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/Rover/failsafe.cpp#L114
